What a shock, the corporate backed board is against universal health care! The Cuban health care system has done so much with so little. Meanwhile the US pours billions into CEOs wallets as average people can’t get care.
washingtonpost.com/opinions/…

We are quickly betting our entire economy on a handful of AI companies and models.

The rise of AI comes with incredible risk to both our economy and people’s lives, and we must ensure it’s being implemented with proper guardrails.

Video

More money has been invested in AI infrastructure than the Manhattan Project and the Apollo program combined.

It is a risky bet and could devastate our economy on a scale similar to the 2008 financial crisis.

I send deep condolences to the family, friends and constituents of Rep. David Scott on his sudden passing. I am grateful to have worked closely with Rep. Scott on furthering regenerative agriculture strategies and other issues. May his memory be a blessing.

Incremental change will not fix our broken health care system.

We need Medicare for All.

Happy Earth Day! I am deeply grateful to have the opportunity to represent a district and state with so much natural beauty.

We must all work together to protect this beautiful planet that we call home.

As Trump and Republicans slash Medicaid, food assistance, and the programs Americans rely on, billionaires are laughing all the way to the bank.

We can and we must fight for better.

Video

Trump’s DOJ is once again targeting and intimidating perceived political enemies.
 
The Southern Poverty Law Center does incredibly important work protecting democracy and promoting civil rights — and I will continue to stand with them. nytimes.com/2026/04/21/us/po…

The DRC is in the midst of an incredibly complex and dangerous humanitarian crisis.

Republicans already gave ICE & CBP $170 billion for lawless immigration enforcement last year. Now, their top priority is to give them another $70 billion when Americans can’t afford healthcare, gas, groceries or rent? What an outrage.

The majority of the American people want universal health care.

Under Medicare for All, you get a government-issued insurance card at birth that you can use your entire life. This way, we can actually cut down on costs and focus on preventive care.

Video

In the richest country in the world, everyone should have quality, affordable health care.

We have to reform our unbelievably broken system.

Good riddance to another one of Trump’s cruel, corrupt cabinet members. 

Once again, another woman has been ousted by Trump. It’s about time to clean house of the incompetent men too — I’m looking at Kash Patel and Pete Hegseth.

Congratulations to Seattle’s own Jane Don't for winning Miss Congeniality on this season of Drag Race!

You were incredible all season long and showcased the amazing LGBTQ+ artistry we have here in Seattle!
Countless trans people have already been forced out of the military because of Trump’s trans military ban. Attempting to kick out those remaining is a gross politicization of our military.

It’s incredibly suspicious that every time Trump is about to make an announcement about the Iran war, there are perfectly timed bets and futures trading.

This needs to be investigated immediately — anyone insider trading must be held accountable. theguardian.com/world/2026/a…
